question: After reading this passage it can be said that it is:
solution:
The correct answer is "**a newspaper article**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage can be a newspaper article owing to the **factual tone **of the passage.
 
• The meticulous attention to detail in terms of **dates **and **institutions **is also similar to that of newspaper articles.
 
• Moreover, the passage relates a **contemporary situation **to **examples **from **history **just like in the newspaper articles.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
